question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Authentic
solution:
The **correct answer** is'** Fake**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Authentic **(असली): This word means genuine, real, and of undisputed origin. It implies something is true and not a copy or imitation.

 
 
• **Example: **"The chef uses only authentic ingredients in her recipes."
 
 
 
• **Fake **(नकली): This word means not genuine, false, or a copy of something real. It is the direct opposite of authentic, indicating something is not genuine or true.
 
 
• **Example: "**The online store was selling fake designer clothing."
 
 
 
• Hence, "**fake**" is the most appropriate antonym of "**authentic**".

Therefore, the **correct answer** is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genuine **(असली): While seemingly close, "genuine" is actually a synonym of "authentic," not an antonym.
 
• **Basic **(मूल): This word simply means fundamental or essential, and doesn't convey the opposite meaning of genuine or real.
 
• **Different **(अलग): This word simply means not the same, but doesn't necessarily imply a lack of genuineness. It can be different but still be authentic.
